description: Replies in a feedback request's thread as the signed-in user; the client gets the reply by email. Use it to ask the client to clarify, or to tell them what changed. If a request is ambiguous, reply_to_feedback asking the client to clarify instead of guessing. Keep replies short and plain (no code). Safe to retry: the same reply isn't posted twice.

message.description: The reply, e.g. "Should the new hours apply to both locations?".

name: reply_to_feedback
title: Reply to client feedback
